# https://www.nokia.com llms.txt

- [Zero-emission mobile networks](https://www.nokia.com/mobile-networks/sustainability/): Maximize energy efficiency with the lowest TCO, reduce embodied emissions and monetize mobile network backup batteries in energy and power reserve markets.​
- [1830 Photonic Service Switch (PSS)](https://www.nokia.com/optical-networks/1830-photonic-service-switch/): Find out how Nokia 1830 PSS family of DWDM multiservice, multilayer P-OTN transport platforms provide efficient transport at any scale.
- [1830 Security Management Server (SMS)](https://www.nokia.com/optical-networks/1830-security-management-server-sms/): How can you protect your layer 1 transport network from a quantum computer attack?
- [7210 Service Access System](https://www.nokia.com/ip-networks/7210-service-access-system/): Transform your network and prepare for growth with high-throughput, high-density access and aggregation routers
- [Quantum-safe optical networking](https://www.nokia.com/optical-networks/secure-optical-transport/): Discover how the Nokia Secure Optical Transport solution protects data in-flight while ensuring data confidentiality, integrity, and high availability.
- [7250 Interconnect Router](https://www.nokia.com/ip-networks/7250-interconnect-router/): Deliver terabit-scale interconnectivity within data centers and WANs in service provider, webscale and enterprise networks to meet increasing traffic demands.
- [MantaRay NM](https://www.nokia.com/mobile-networks/ran-operations/network-management/): A field proven network management system that provides mobile network operators with a comprehensive view of multi-domain, multi-technology networks.
- [Managed Security Services](https://www.nokia.com/mobile-networks/services/managed-services/security/): Enhance your cybersecurity architecture with our 24x7 telecom network solution to rapidly prevent and stop cyber threats.
- [Fiber ONT](https://www.nokia.com/fixed-networks/fiber-ont/): Your optical network terminal is your face to your customer, so it had better be good. Get the best fiber ONT for your FTTH broadband services. Read more.
- [Optical Data Center Interconnect](https://www.nokia.com/optical-networks/data-center-interconnect/): Implement business-critical data center interconnect to support your enterprise private/hybrid cloud.
- [Fixed Wireless Access](https://www.nokia.com/fixed-networks/fastmile-fwa/): With 5G fixed wireless access (FWA) you can deliver fiber-like broadband to customers wherever you have mobile spectrum. Learn more.
- [7705 Service Aggregation Router](https://www.nokia.com/ip-networks/7705-service-aggregation-router/): The 7705 SAR family delivers multiservice access and aggregation for enterprises, communications service providers and mission-critical networks.
- [IP-optical coordination](https://www.nokia.com/ip-optical-coordination/): Transform and optimize your network for an on-demand world with IP/optical integration solutions from Nokia.
- [Altiplano Access Controller](https://www.nokia.com/fixed-networks/altiplano-access-controller/): Altiplano is the modular, programmable, unified network management platform for network analytics.
- [Cloud Mobile Gateway](https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/cloud-mobile-gateway/): Nokia Cloud Mobility Manager is a key element of the Nokia Cloud Packet Core solution, that delivers extreme high-performance and flexibility on Any Cloud.
- [PSTN Smart Transform](https://www.nokia.com/fixed-networks/pstn-smart-transform/): Alcatel-Lucent PSTN Smart Transform helps service providers achieve fast, first-time-right legacy migration that reduces costs and increases revenue.
- [Cloud Mobility Manager](https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/cloud-mobility-manager/): Nokia Cloud Mobility Manager provides the scale and signaling processing performance you need for mobile broadband, IoT/MTC, and future 5G services.
- [Cloud Signaling Director](https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/cloud-signaling-director/): Improve signaling plane efficiency, security, and performance with the Nokia Dynamic Diameter Engine.
- [Software-Defined Access Networks](https://www.nokia.com/fixed-networks/software-defined-access-networks/): Nokia software-defined access networks virtualize and centralize network functionilty in the cloud, renewing agility and the ability to scale.
- [Subscriber Data Management](https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/subscriber-data-management/): Reaping the benefits of 5G and cloud
- [Utility broadband](https://www.nokia.com/industries/power-utilities/utility-broadband/): Bring ultra-broadband services and enhanced power delivery to your community
- [Session Border Controller](https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/session-border-controller/): Nokia Session Border Controller (SBC) economically and reliably secures control and media traffic for 4G and 5G networks.
- [Mission-critical WAN for highways](https://www.nokia.com/industries/highways/mission-critical-wan/): Open the gates to increased flexibility while maintaining safety and security
- [Convergent Charging solutions](https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/converged-charging/): Take advantage of 5G monetization opportunities in converged charging with Nokia Convergent Charging solutions
- [Mission-critical railway backbone network](https://www.nokia.com/industries/railways/mission-critical-transmission-networks/): Support mission critical applications and new passenger services with Microwave, Optical and IP technologies.
- [Telecom Application Server](https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/telecom-application-server/): Nokia TAS is built according to IMS core architecture, providing a super set of services for VoLTE, Voice over WiFi and fixed-access networks.
- [Mission-critical WAN for power utilities](https://www.nokia.com/industries/power-utilities/mission-critical-wan/): With our IP/MPLS network for utilities, you can build a secure, reliable WAN that enables smart grid communications for control, monitoring and automation.
- [Traffica](https://www.nokia.com/ai-and-analytics/traffica/): A network analytics tool providing real-time data of subscriber activity across every cell for optimized network planning, operations, and customer service.
- [Video Broadcast Optimizer](https://www.nokia.com/ip-networks/video-broadcast-optimizer/): The video broadcast optimizer delivers near-zero latency in content delivery networks for live IP video streaming in video broadcast distribution
- [Virtualized Service Router](https://www.nokia.com/ip-networks/virtualized-service-router/): Deliver a wide, rich set of virtualized network functions (VNFs) for x86 server environments

- [Service Router Operating System (SR OS)](https://www.nokia.com/ip-networks/service-router-operating-system-nos/): The Nokia service router operating system (SR OS) is built to power the most demanding and dynamic Ethernet and IP/MPLS networks.

- [6G radio protocols: Architecting for tomorrow’s diverse connectivity needs](https://www.nokia.com/6g/6g-radio-protocols-architecting-for-tomorrows-diverse-connectivity-needs/): Cloud-native principles help telco operators deal with network operation complexity using virtualization technologies such as NFV and SDN for automation.
- [Nokia, Vodafone and RingCentral to showcase future of voice calls at Mobile World Congress #MWC25](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/02/25/nokia-vodafone-and-ringcentral-to-showcase-future-of-voice-calls-at-mobile-world-congress-mwc25/): Press ReleaseNokia, Vodafone and RingCentral to showcase future of voice calls at Mobile World Congress #MWC25 
- [Microwave transport](https://www.nokia.com/mobile-networks/microwave-transport/): Advance 5G and critical connectivity with high-performance, reliable, green and cost-efficient microwave transport.
- [Nokia completes acquisition of Infinera to create innovation powerhouse in optical networks, with the scale to power the data center revolution](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/02/28/nokia-completes-acquisition-of-infinera-to-create-innovation-powerhouse-in-optical-networks-with-the-scale-to-power-the-data-center-revolution/): Nokia completes acquisition of Infinera to create innovation powerhouse in optical networks, with the scale to power the data center revolution
- [Nokia and industry partners accelerate AI-RAN development #MWC25](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/03/02/nokia-and-industry-partners-accelerate-ai-ran-development-mwc25/): Press ReleaseNokia and industry partners accelerate AI-RAN development #MWC25 
- [UN Women 2024 community collaboration](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/sustainability/bridging-digital-divide/un-women-community-collaboration/): Acting together to expand social impact and close the digital gap.
- [On the road to web3](https://www.nokia.com/innovation/technology-vision/on-the-road-to-web3/): Discover how world is transforming towards Web3, reimagining the Internet.
- [Networked](https://www.nokia.com/cloud-and-network-services/networked/): The Networked video series features thought leadership conversations with Nokia’s Raghav Sahgal and telecom leaders on topics shaping the industry today.
- [Nokia and Honeywell Aerospace Technologies partner with Numana to advance quantum-safe networks](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/03/24/nokia-and-honeywell-aerospace-technologies-partner-with-numana-to-advance-quantum-safe-networks/): Press ReleaseNokia and Honeywell Aerospace Technologies partner with Numana to advance quantum-safe networks
- [Mission-critical WAN for defense](https://www.nokia.com/industries/defense/mission-critical-wan/): Build the resilient, secure and high-capacity communications foundation you need for modern defense operations with our multiservice WAN infrastructure.
- [Programmable connectivity](https://www.nokia.com/programmable-networks/network-as-code/use-cases/programmable-connectivity/): Your applications can shape telecom bandwidth to meet their needs.
- [Wavelengths  APAC-MEA 2025 Speakers](https://www.nokia.com/events/wavelengths/apac/speakers/): A unique, invitation-only event designed to provide attendees from the APAC and MEA regions with the latest information on Nokia’s optical network solutions.
- [On the road to spatial computing](https://www.nokia.com/innovation/technology-vision/on-the-road-to-spatial-computing/): Discover how spatial computing merges digital and physical worlds, transforming our interactions with technology and reshaping how we experience reality.
- [Nokia Corporation Interim Report for Q1 2025](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/04/24/nokia-corporation-interim-report-for-q1-2025/): Nokia Corporation
- [Device Insights](https://www.nokia.com/programmable-networks/network-as-code/use-cases/device-insights/): Leveraging device insights for tomorrow’s applications.
- [Digital identity verification and fraud prevention](https://www.nokia.com/programmable-networks/network-as-code/use-cases/digital-identity-verification-fraud-prevention/): Secure application experiences with real time signals.
- [FRMCS 5G radio](https://www.nokia.com/industries/railways/frmcs/5g-radio/): Find out how our railway communications solutions can help you build a digital railway that ensures safe, on-time and fully connected journeys.
- [Resolutions of Nokia Corporation’s Annual General Meeting](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/04/29/resolutions-of-nokia-corporations-annual-general-meeting/): Nokia CorporationStock Exchange Release29 April 2025 at 15.45 EEST Resolutions of Nokia Corporation’s Annual General Meeting
- [Mediation](https://www.nokia.com/autonomous-networks/mediation/): Turn your data into business value
- [Nokia selected by CoreSite for routing-based network edge solution to support data-intensive, mission-critical applications](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/05/13/nokia-selected-by-coresite-for-routing-based-network-edge-solution-to-support-data-intensive-mission-critical-applications/): Press Release Nokia selected by CoreSite for routing-based network edge solution to support data-intensive, mission-critical applications
- [Remote drone operations](https://www.nokia.com/programmable-networks/network-as-code/industries/drones/): Plan routes, manage flights and ensure compliance using API-driven programmable connectivity and insights
- [5 misconceptions about Q-Day](https://www.nokia.com/quantum/5-misconceptions-about-q-day/): Q-Day is coming, but there is still a lot of confusion about what this means for the security of our networks.
- [Building optical networks for AI, with AI](https://www.nokia.com/optical-networks/ai/): Nokia optical networks for AI help you meet the demands of AI-enabled applications and use AI to simplify, scale and get maximum value from your network.
- [Charting the path to 6G](https://www.nokia.com/6g/): 6G networks will seamlessly blend virtual and physical realities, enabling humans to intuitively move between the digital, physical, and human worlds.
- [Colt, Honeywell and Nokia join forces to trial space-based quantum-safe cryptography](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/06/02/colt-honeywell-and-nokia-join-forces-to-trial-space-based-quantum-safe-cryptography/): Press ReleaseColt, Honeywell and Nokia join forces to trial space-based quantum-safe cryptography
- [CSC, SURF and Nokia Achieve 1.2 Tbit/s Data Transfer to prepare long haul network for new LUMI-AI supercomputer and AI Factories](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/06/04/csc-surf-and-nokia-achieve-12-tbits-data-transfer-to-prepare-long-haul-network-for-new-lumi-ai-supercomputer-and-ai-factories/): Press ReleaseCSC, SURF and Nokia Achieve 1.2 Tbit/s Data Transfer to prepare long haul network for new LUMI-AI supercomputer and AI Factories
- [AI and automation redefine the future of networks](https://www.nokia.com/mobile-networks/aI-and-automation-redefine-the-future-of-networks/): Nokia offers advanced automation for advanced networks, helping customers build a future-proof technology foundation for their business.
- [Telstra and Nokia partner to unlock network APIs for developers and enterprises](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/06/17/telstra-and-nokia-partner-to-unlock-network-apis-for-developers-and-enterprises/): Press releaseTelstra and Nokia partner to unlock network APIs for developers and enterprises
- [Nokia selected by Verizon as hardware and software provider for Thames Freeport multisite private 5G deal](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/06/25/nokia-selected-by-verizon-as-hardware-and-software-provider-for-thames-freeport-multisite-private-5g-deal/): Press ReleaseNokia selected by Verizon as hardware and software provider for Thames Freeport multisite private 5G deal
- [Nokia Corporation Report for Q2 and Half Year 2025](https://www.nokia.com/about-us/news/releases/2025/07/24/nokia-corporation-report-for-q2-and-half-year-2025/): Nokia Corporation Half year financial report24 July 2025 at 08:00 EEST Nokia Corporation Report for Q2 and Half Year 2025
- [Mission-critical communications](https://www.nokia.com/core-networks/mission-critical-communications/): Nokia delivers secure, reliable private wireless networks for public safety, utilities, and railways enabling future-ready communications.
- [Quantum physics is reshaping the fundamentals of networking](https://www.nokia.com/quantum/quantum-physics-is-reshaping-the-fundamentals-of-networking/): Nokia Bell Labs is manipulating photons of light in new ways, leading to new possibilities in optical communications.
- [SReXperts 25 Americas event speakers](https://www.nokia.com/events/srexperts/americas/speakers/): A unique, invitation-only event designed to provide attendees from the Americas region with the latest information on Nokia’s IP solutions.
- [Wavelengths Americas 2025 - Speakers](https://www.nokia.com/events/wavelengths/americas/speakers/): A unique, invitation-only event designed to provide attendees from the Americas region with the latest information on Nokia’s optical network solutions.
- [IP/MPLS or MPLS-TP](https://www.nokia.com/industries/power-utilities/ip-mpls-or-mpls-tp/): Discover the key factors to consider in choosing between IP/MPLS and MPLS-TP to modernize your grid communications network.
